# Entity resolution calibration

<!-- Generated by `neonradar er calibrate --size large --seed 20261026` (PHASE-2.md M2.10b). Do not edit by hand: run the command again. -->

The large synthetic entity resolution benchmark (seed 20261026, M2.9) was scored once by the two Splink models down to a match probability of 0.50, and the constrained clustering of PHASE-2.md 7.1.6 then ran again on the stored pairs for each threshold `t` below, without scoring again. The measures are those of PHASE-2.md 7.1.7: pairwise precision and recall of each class with `merge_threshold = t` for both models, the hard negatives merged at that threshold, and the recall of policy-blocked true pairs (P1, P2) as possible matches with `candidate_threshold = t` and the merge thresholds of `er.yaml`.

Libraries: duckdb 1.5.6, pyarrow 26.0.0, splink 5.0.0. Comparisons generated by blocking: person 58355, organisation 11185. Pairs scored at 0.50 or more: person model 16015, organisation model 9053. One DuckDB thread, training seed 20261026.

## Proposed values

The rule of PHASE-2.md 7.1.7: for each class the lowest merge threshold whose precision is at least 0.98, and the highest candidate threshold whose policy-blocked recall is at least 0.9.

| Setting | Proposed | In er.yaml now |
|---|---|---|
| `merge_threshold.person` | 0.9999 | 0.99 |
| `merge_threshold.org` | 0.5 | 0.995 |
| `candidate_threshold` | none passes | 0.8 |

`er calibrate` never edits `resolve/config/er.yaml`. The tech lead and the graph mentor choose the values at the freeze and record them, with this table, in ADR-0014. The thresholds come from the synthetic benchmark only: no real pair is labelled before the evaluation sample is drawn (G10, PHASE-2.md 7.3).
